title: Realms: The Sundered Shelf
tagline: A third-person fantasy action RPG that is generated entirely in code and runs in a browser tab.
stateNote: A hosted build runs on my Vercel. You can also run it locally or build it as a single HTML file.
problem: No plugins and no binary assets: the terrain, sky, water, characters, music and sound are all made at load.
audience: Action RPG fans and procedural-generation tinkerers.
contribution: It is my project. The repository is named 'aetherwake'.
worksToday: The README describes a Warden with a wolf companion crossing a valley to a silent Keep.

involve.headline: Curious about the build?
asks: Tell me if a single-file build is something you'd use.
